subject: general
question: On which date is India likely to experience the shortest day of the year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**22 December**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shortest Day **of the **Year **in the **Northern Hemisphere**.
 
• The **December solstice **is on either **December 20, 21, 22, or 23**.
 
• **The North Pole **is tilted **furthest from the Sun**.
 
• It is the **winter solstice **in the **Northern Hemisphere**, where it is **the shortest day of the year**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In the **southern hemisphere**, **22nd December **has the **longest day **and the **shortest night**.
 
• **June 21 **is the **summer solstice**, the **longest day **and **shortest night **of the **year **in the **Northern Hemisphere**.
 
• On **21st June **sun rays **fall vertically **over the **Tropic of Cancer**. This **position **of the Earth **is called Summer Solstice. **It is the **shortest **day of **southern hemisphere**.
